result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. A few minor visual issues were found related to text truncation and inconsistent icon styling.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card on the right edge of 'Fastest near you' is cut off, showing truncated text and only a partial card.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a horizontal carousel, but ensure the card peek indicates scrollability clearly and that the restaurant name truncates with an ellipsis rather than being abruptly cut.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently: the first (Tokumaru Ramen) has a white background with dark outline, while the second (pizza) has a dark filled background with white outline.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon styling across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom is partially visible and its name/details are cut off below the fold.
issues.suggestion: This is expected due to scrolling, but confirm the layout scrolls correctly to reveal the full card.
